module: Additional scene views of the editor: each "Scene view N" is an ImGui window that displays the world via an ImguiRenderViewControl, with its own mode (3D, last selected camera, orthographic), near/far planes, FOV, position/rotation, icon and gizmo visibility, and debug draw mask. Also draws a debug grid. The state of the views is saved with the editor layout (onSerialize/onDeserialized) and restored at initialization.
notes: Default values of a view: nearClip 0.01, farClip 2500, fov 70, renderDebugDrawMask -1 (everything).
Trap: `data.attachToObject or true` is always true, so the saved value false is lost on reload.

onEditorGui.desc: Called every frame: creates a pending view ("Add Scene View" menu) then draws each view window, its control menus (mode, clips, FOV, ortho) and updates the render camera.

onEditorInitialized.desc: Called when the editor initializes: recreates the views from the deserialized data, then adds the "Add Scene View" menu.

onSerialize.desc: Serializes the state of all views (mode, clips, fov, pos, rot, display options, debug mask).

onDeserialized.desc: Stores the saved data until the editor is initialized (onEditorInitialized uses it).
